name: Pogo Hop / Jump
instructions: Hop repeatedly on the balls of your feet, using only the ankles.
Keep the knees nearly straight — bounce like a pogo stick.
Land quietly and rebound instantly. Builds ankle stiffness for running and jumping.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: A beginner just your bodyweight core exercise for the calves. Pogo Hop / Jump builds the trunk stability that underpins safe movement as you age.
